scheme: Concession and Incentive Scheme for long-haul international services
benefit: Up to 67% off vessel-related charges, depending on route (links beyond Singapore/Port Kelang, Jebel Ali, Salalah, key African ports) and call frequency
source_title: Indian Infrastructure, 25 Nov 2025

scheme: Scale of Rates: rates are ceiling levels; coastal concession conditions
benefit: Rates in the Scale of Rates are ceilings; coastal cargo and vessels get concessional rates
source_title: VOC Port Authority, General Scale of Rates

scheme: Discount for container lines
benefit: 75% discount on vessel-related charges to interested container lines; no container scanning charges
source_title: Paradip Port Authority, news

scheme: Discounted rates for one cargo through the iron ore handling plant (IOHP)
benefit: Discounted cargo-related charges for a named cargo handled through a specific facility
source_title: Paradip Port Authority, Traffic Department office order

scheme: Performance Norm based Incentive/Penalty Scheme (dry bulk, break bulk, project cargo)
benefit: Rewards handling faster than the norm and penalises slower handling
source_title: Paradip Port Authority, circulars

scheme: Performance norms based incentive and penalty scheme
benefit: Productivity norms per cargo (e.g. MS 750 t/hour); incentive above, penalty below
period: Trade Notice 06/2024; revised 13/2026 (1 Oct 2026 to 30 Sep 2027)
source_title: Cochin Port Authority, trade notices

scheme: Vessel-related charges concession for feeder vessels connecting Colombo (tiered by TEUs and vessel size)
benefit: 7.5% to 40% by TEUs per call and vessel size
source_title: Cochin Port Authority, Trade Notice 06/2026 (held in the project)

scheme: Concession for new container services to and from Middle East ports
benefit: 50% off vessel-related charges for new services with at least 2 Middle East ports and 2 calls every 30 days
source_title: Cochin Port Authority, Trade Notice 11/2026 (held in the project)

scheme: Exemption of port and vessel charges for RoPax and passenger ferries
benefit: Exemption and priority berthing
source_title: Cochin Port Authority, trade notices

scheme: Discount for cargo to and from Shahid Beheshti Port, Chabahar
benefit: Discount on vessel-related and container-related charges for Chabahar cargo
source_title: JNPA, circulars and trade notices

scheme: Rebate on wharfage of bagged cargo
benefit: Wharfage rebate for bagged cargo
source_title: Kandla Port Steamship Agents Association, list of Deendayal circulars

scheme: Concession in railway terminal charges
benefit: Concession on railway terminal charges
source_title: Kandla Port Steamship Agents Association, list of Deendayal circulars

scheme: Discount on vessel-related charges for coal, coke and salt vessels at a PPP dry bulk terminal
benefit: Discount on vessel-related charges for named bulk cargos
source_title: Kandla Port Steamship Agents Association, list of Deendayal circulars

scheme: Concessions based on parcel size of salt vessels
benefit: Concessions for larger salt parcels; salt handled rose by about 8.5 million t in 2024-25
source_title: India Seatrade News

scheme: Wharfage for cargo landed only for reshipment
benefit: 75% of the applicable wharfage for each handling
source_title: Deendayal Port, Scale of Rates

scheme: Harit Shrey: discount on port charges by Environmental Ship Index score
benefit: Discount on port charges for ships with higher ESI scores; first major port to do so
source_title: Ministry of Ports, Annual Report 2024-25

scheme: Coastal concession
benefit: 40% concession for coastal vessels and cargo, except thermal coal and POL including crude
source_title: DG Shipping, Coastal Shipping committee report, Jan 2026

scheme: Non-Containerized Cargo Incentive Scheme (NCCS) 2026-27
benefit: Graded wharfage concessions of up to 80% on incremental volume over a base year; loyalty bonus up to 10%; MoUs for long-term cargo commitments. Liquid bulk (not POL), dry bulk and break bulk on port-operated berths
source_title: NCPL news, Chennai Port Authority launches NCCS 2026-27

scheme: NCCS 2026-27 loyalty bonus and long-term commitments
design_pattern: Annual volume discount or loyalty bonus
benefit: Loyalty bonus up to 10% for customers who keep routing cargo through Chennai; long-term commitment MoUs
source_title: Port Wings, Chennai Port launches NCCS

scheme: Quantity discount on seaport dues
design_pattern: Annual volume discount or loyalty bonus
benefit: Discount per shipping line per year by total tonnes on liner services: 6% to 22% (deep sea), 5% to 21% (short sea/feeder, RoRo); volume estimated at the start of the year from schedules
source_title: Port of Rotterdam, Quantity discount

scheme: Transhipment discount
benefit: Discount on loaded sea-in/sea-out containers transhipped between deep sea and feeder; paid annually after the year, on request
source_title: Port of Rotterdam, Transhipment discount

scheme: Discount for sharing location data
benefit: 5% discount on inland port dues for barges that share location data with the Port Authority via a tracker
source_title: Hansa, Rotterdam changes fare system

scheme: Discount for double calls (Antwerp and Zeebrugge)
benefit: 10% discount on tonnage dues in 2026 for ships calling at both Antwerp and Zeebrugge consecutively; 20% announced from 2027
source_title: Port of Antwerp-Bruges, Tariff adjustments 2026

scheme: Automatic Green Award discount for barges
benefit: Barges with Green Award Gold (10%) or Platinum (15%) get the discount automatically, without submitting documents for each barge
source_title: Port of Antwerp-Bruges, Automatic discount for Green Award inland vessels

scheme: Bonuses under Article 245.3 of Spain's ports law
benefit: Each Port Authority may give bonuses of up to 40% to strategic traffics; total bonuses in a year capped at 20% of combined fee income; bonuses on one fee for one traffic capped at 40% together
period: Annual, set in the State budget law
source_title: Valenciaport, 2023 Tasa Pasaje (Art. 245.3 limits)

scheme: Rail bonus on the cargo fee
benefit: 40% bonus for new vehicles and platforms entering or leaving the port by rail
source_title: Valenciaport, Tasas y bonificaciones en vigor 2021

scheme: Provisional application with year-end regularisation
benefit: Bonuses applied provisionally on each bill, then regularised at the end of the year
source_title: Valenciaport, Tasas y bonificaciones en vigor 2022

scheme: Green Flag vessel speed reduction
benefit: 15% (20 nm) or 25% (40 nm) lower dockage for operators whose ships slow to 12 knots on at least 90% of calls; compliance checked from ship tracking (AIS) data
source_title: US EPA Ports Initiative, Vessel speed reduction
